text: Help people understand, internalize and express the meaning of Scripture through FIA resources; translation recording and checking are outside the proposed initial scope.
Support communal engagement while allowing individual use of the resources.
Make audio, video, images and related resources easy to reach without learning a complicated navigation structure.
Support a guided flow that can pause for questions or discussion and then resume the relevant resources.
Explore a phone-first, portrait-oriented experience; broader device support is not established by this proposal.
Support offline use with deliberate selection, download and removal of resource content to fit device storage.
Use a deterministic guided flow as a proposed starting point, with AI assistance potentially added without making that initial flow depend on it.
Explore conversational control of navigation and app actions beyond a chat panel that only answers questions; this is not a confirmed feature or a claim about the first demonstration.
Preserve the resource metadata needed by the experience, including timing links, when choosing how content reaches the app.
Reduce media transfer size for constrained connections while checking that the resulting resources remain usable.
